description: Unofficial current-source NCAP and outdoor-program guidance for Scouting America camp administrators, volunteers, and seasonal camp leaders.

capabilities: Camp program staffing and qualification analysis
defaultPrompt: What permits/documents/facilities inspections are needed by NCAP for long-term summer camp?
What staff qualifications and ratios are needed to offer the programs listed on this schedule?
Review this proposed camp activity for NCAP, safety, and policy issues.
interface.longDescription: An unofficial advisor for Scouting America camp administrators, volunteers, professional staff, program directors, and seasonal camp leaders. It helps apply current NCAP standards, Guide to Safe Scouting, SAFE, National Camping School qualifications, program-specific guidance, staffing and supervision rules, and practical camp operations. Answers default to concise, decision-oriented guidance and verify current official Scouting America sources before treating a policy as controlling. State, county, local, and labor-law research is brought in only when the user's question actually turns on those requirements. The plugin is independent and does not represent Scouting America, an NCAP assessment team, a regulator, or an attorney.

name: unofficial-ncap-advisor
